VERIFICATION LOG — EVIDENCE
### 2026-10-02 — worker — activated

Selected one measured-cost boundary under the user's renewed throughput priority.
Parent is `96f30bdee9d0a98672336b223004054677baee36` (verified E5.5-T03bf).
The baseline wasm is preserved in `/tmp/wasm-vm-direct-memory-baseline` and bound
by `evidence/jit-direct-memory/baseline.json`. The prior MIPS task remains unchanged.

### 2026-10-02 — worker — implemented

Frozen implementation: `7e51177d966e05f7ae8b3ae23c7d5d0d028c404b`, parent
`96f30bdee9d0a98672336b223004054677baee36`. Runtime source and committed wasm are
bound by `evidence/jit-direct-memory/frozen.json`; wasm SHA-256 is
`4f1005a174e6dba3cf698d503a21a10168f4ff37db2c2419fbae86fb2f8a787b`.
Only the owning browser wasm's memory import boundary changed. Native source trees
are unchanged. Raw exports guard inactive HOST pointers before calling the
existing load/store/atomic helpers; successful atomics retain chain aborts.

`make verify-E5.5-T03bg` passes: 5 worker tests, 2 independent verifier tests and
38 existing parity tests (1 existing ignored). The 100 directed memory cases
record literal/reference state and instruction-state digests, aggregate
`ee01061fe9fb4cf5612d065557c1dc7c2d33a01567748aa516d145bd3c4c80bc` in each mode.
Coverage includes five scalar signatures, 19 rejected signature mutations per
mode, trampoline substitution, every scalar width, AMO/LR/SC, high bits, precise
fault prefixes, all three atomic exits with a traversable-edge control, MMIO,
SMC, TLB refill, reservations and growth. Fresh two-machine lifetime tests cover
55 inactive calls and 8 compiled calls per mode. Evidence:
`acceptance-screen.log`, `verifier/cold-clone.{json,log}` and
`verifier/guard-sabotage.{json,log,patch}` under `evidence/jit-direct-memory/`.
The scrubbed clean clone at the frozen head passes; removing only the load guard
in that isolated clone fails, restoring it passes. No runtime change followed.

Final commands: two sequential invocations of
`node tools/verify/jit-direct-memory-benchmark.mjs NEW_OUT /tmp/wasm-vm-direct-memory-baseline`,
then `node tools/perf/bench-browser.mjs --root baseline=/tmp/wasm-vm-direct-memory-baseline --root candidate=/Users/blamy/.codex/worktrees/mips-throughput/wasm-vm --out evidence/jit-direct-memory/browser-final --samples 5 --cases busybox-jit,busybox-nojit --releases /Users/blamy/Documents/Codex/wasm-vm/releases --chrome '/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome'`.
`final-timing-receipt.json` contains exact argv, exits, log and before/after hashes.
Both seven-pair batches preserve exact states and budgets: AMO improves
1.195–1.206×, LR/SC 1.366–1.378×, forced InlineTLB collisions 2.500–2.521×.
Controls stay within budget. All 20 real runs succeed; JIT boot is
4.869→4.784 s and shell 3.920→3.868 s (approximately neutral); interpreter
controls are 0.89%/0.41% slower. Ratio-of-medians and paired-median budgets both
pass in `performance-acceptance.json`, independently recalculated by the critic.
Every sample and the preliminary slower shell screen are retained. Real RTC work
varies, so these are host-duration comparisons, not exact guest equivalence.
Candidate shell is 42.9 MIPS with JIT and 57.9 without it; integer loops reach
656–657 MIPS. No 300-MIPS Linux or desktop-latency claim is made.

Risk submission is recorded in `gates/summary.md` and
`gates/submission-diagnostics.json`: format, affected strict clippy, 33 native
wrapper tests, six feature builds and no-host-float pass. Broad actual-wasm run
has 248 passes, 1 inherited snapshot assertion failure, 1 ignored, and 19 later
targets plus doctests unrun. Broad clippy, macOS `make ci`/wvseccomp and the
GPU-test determinism scan have retained inherited failures, with parent hashes
and historical failure citations. These are not described as green. The only
post-freeze harness edit adds error URLs/statuses; syntax and final execution
pass, and its exact hash is recorded.

`demo-frozen/demo-suite.json` and `demo-live-worker/demo-suite.json` show 127/127
ISA cases, 31/31 live direct-memory capability and zero unexpected errors, with
screenshots. `bash tools/deploy-cloudflare.sh` succeeded at
https://134c1d26.wasm-vm.pages.dev and https://wasm-vm.pages.dev.
`live-worker-hashes.json` matches live wasm/roadmap/tasks/service-worker bytes to
the frozen committed artifacts. Deployment log and manifests are retained.
Submission guide: `evidence/jit-direct-memory/README.md`. PR #402 remains draft
and unmerged. Fresh verifier verdict and verified metadata publication follow.

### 2026-10-02 — independent verifier — VERDICT: verified

VERDICT: verified

Reviewed worker submission `367caccdd765b215f3a7928586da91b089ac845d` against the
frozen runtime `7e51177d966e05f7ae8b3ae23c7d5d0d028c404b` and parent
`96f30bdee9d0a98672336b223004054677baee36`. Predictions were written before
inspecting worker outputs in `evidence/jit-direct-memory/verifier/predictions.md`.
Full prediction outcomes, changed-hunk coverage, commands and citations are in
`evidence/jit-direct-memory/verifier/review.md`; all P1–P11 held.

- **Identity, faults and atomic state — HELD.** The scrubbed pristine clone's
  `make verify-E5.5-T03bg` passes strict affected clippy and all direct tests.
  `verifier/cold-clone.log:218,274` proves five raw identities/signatures and 19
  rejected type mutations per mode; `:165-215,221-271` records 50 literal/state/
  reference-trace cases per mode with matching aggregate `ee01061f…c4c80bc`.
  All five high-address faults preserve the one-instruction prefix (`:207-211`);
  all three atomic abort paths preserve the two-instruction block prefix and
  stop a proven traversable successor (`:160-162`). Existing MMIO, TLB, SMC and
  growth parity checks pass (`:335-355`).
- **Independent lifetime/guard attack — HELD.** Two guests at identical addresses
  retain distinct high-bit values and LR reservations; dropping the last-entered
  guest leaves its survivor correct through SC/AMO and 65,536-byte memory growth
  (`verifier/cold-clone.log:296,299`, eight compiled calls/55 inactive probes per
  mode). Removing only the load guard in the isolated clone causes an actual null
  dereference and fails the exact-null assertion (`verifier/guard-sabotage.log:19-20,37-40`);
  restoration passes (`verifier/guard-restored.log:19-22`). The worker runtime was
  never mutated. Cold log SHA-256 is `4360885099d147e34e19643b3b59f1f31149a629f47e50dba30da08277dc8063`.
- **Performance — HELD.** Independent raw recomputation in
  `verifier/performance-review.json` validates exact parent/candidate artifact
  hashes, both seven-pair batches, all 20 real samples, fixed work/state, order,
  policy and errors. AMO gains 1.195–1.206×, LR/SC 1.366–1.378× and TLB collisions
  2.500–2.521×; paired and unpaired budgets both pass. Real JIT boot/shell changes
  are small (4.869→4.784 s / 3.920→3.868 s); interpreter controls stay under 1%
  regression. No 300-MIPS desktop or broad responsiveness improvement is proven.
- **Risk gates and coverage — HELD with retained limitations.** The clean clone
  starts with no target and ends clean; runtime and both test fixtures remain
  byte-identical to the frozen head. Every changed runtime hunk executes or is
  waived as documentation/deleted closure plumbing. The full-wasm resume failure
  is a pre-existing pure section predicate/test mismatch, reproduced in older
  `evidence/omarchy-profile/direct-fp-imports-r1/ci.log:665-666`; both files and all
  native runtime sources are unchanged. The 19 later wasm targets and doctests
  remain explicitly unrun. Other inherited broad-clippy, macOS seccomp and GPU
  test-scan failures are retained, not called green.
- **Live browser/artifacts — HELD.** The critic inspected the live screenshot and
  capture: 127/127 ISA cases, 31/31 live capability, zero unexpected errors.
  Independent fresh downloads of live wasm/roadmap/tasks/service-worker bytes
  match the frozen committed dist and `live-worker-hashes.json`; runtime hash is
  `4f1005a174e6dba3cf698d503a21a10168f4ff37db2c2419fbae86fb2f8a787b`.
- **SUITE:** retain both independent lifetime tests, literal/ABI/atomic fixtures
  and `make verify-E5.5-T03bg`. Keep recorded digests, raw samples and the isolated
  sabotage patch/log; never retain the broken mutant as runtime code. No merge.

Only verifier metadata/status/queue changed for this verdict. The coordinator
will refresh and republish verified web metadata after this commit.
ADVERSARIAL VERIFICATION
A fresh verifier predicts before inspecting evidence. Attack null/stale host
contexts, signature mismatches and trampoline substitution, memory faults after
retired prefixes, high-bit addresses/values, reservation lifecycle, MMIO and
SMC invalidation, and imported outer-memory growth. Check every changed helper executes
in recorded acceptance, including each atomic chain-abort path. Invent one
bounded novel attack and sabotage one assertion in isolation. Recalculate the
paired performance samples and verify the baseline is PR #401's exact runtime.
Only the verifier sets verified; no merge is authorized.
